BiblicalUsage: Sega is increasing, multiplying, and it opens the letters of two kings: Nebuchadnezzar writes to all people, nations, and languages, Peace be multiplied unto you; and Darius writes the same after the lions' den, Peace be multiplied unto you.
TheologicalSignificance: What I take from this is that even pagan kings learned to bless with multiplication, once they had seen what the God of Daniel does.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
